title: Google Calendar
description: Gives agents read and write access to Google Calendar with the org's bound Google account. The add-on calls the Calendar v3 API; the token is injected by the host and never enters the add-on process. Event listing, creation, patching and deletion work against any calendar the account can see, the primary calendar by default.

permissions.reason: Call the Google Calendar v3 API with the bound account
Use the Google account bound to the calendar connection

descriptor.name: calendar
descriptor.title: Google Calendar tools
descriptor.description: List calendars and events, create, update and delete events on Google Calendar

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List the Google calendars of the connected account with their ids, time zones and access roles. Use it to find the calendarId for the other calendar tools; the primary calendar id is 'primary'.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of calendars to return (default 100)

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound to the add-on

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List Google Calendar events on one calendar, expanded into single occurrences and ordered by start time. Filter by time range (RFC 3339) and free-text query.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound to the add-on

query.description: Free-text search across summary, description, location and attendees

maxResults.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 25)

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a Google Calendar event. start and end are RFC 3339 date-times, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event (then end is exclusive).

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound to the add-on

start.description: Start: RFC 3339 date-time or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event

end.description: End: RFC 3339 date-time or YYYY-MM-DD (exclusive) for an all-day event

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update fields of an existing Google Calendar event; pass only the fields to change. Use list_events to find eventId.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound to the add-on

start.description: New start: RFC 3339 date-time or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event

end.description: New end: RFC 3339 date-time or YYYY-MM-DD (exclusive) for an all-day event

attendees.description: Replaces the attendee list with these email addresses

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete (cancel) a Google Calendar event by id. Deletion is permanent for the calendar: the event disappears for every attendee.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound to the add-on
